plan_contract.boundary: A0 checks structure, unique coverage and references; A1 verifier checks process and scheduling constraints.

semantic_rules: segment IDs, robot IDs and resource IDs are unique and non-empty
segments of each parent curve use contiguous zero-based segment_index values
adjacent segments of one parent curve meet geometrically within 1e-6 m
not_splittable parent curves contain exactly one segment
predecessor references exist and form a directed acyclic graph
sampled curves contain at least two finite 3D points and match start/end poses
poses use a finite position and a unit xyzw quaternion
all internal values use SI units
